versions.content: Constraints for the structure of the target of an URI-based reference The EcucDestinationUriPolicy exists to define constraints for the structure and content of EcucContainerDef s, which want to become the target of a URI-based reference. It provides the following attributes: • Attribute destinationUriNestingContract describes the scope to which the constraints shall apply. • Attribute container describes properties either of – the EcucContainerDef that is itself a valid target of the URI-based ref- erence (in case of destinationUriNestingContract set to leafOf- TargetContainer ) – the EcucContainerDef that is owned by the valid target of the URI- based reference (in case of other values of destinationUriNesting- Contract ). In both cases, the shortName of the EcucContainerDef , as well as the struc- ture of the container (which other EcucDefinitionElement s it aggregates) are important properties. • Attribute parameter describes properties of the EcucParameterDef that is owned by the a valid target of the URI-based reference. Important properties in the context are, for example, the shortName and the multiplicity ( lowerMulti- plicity and upperMultiplicity ) of the EcucParameterDef . • Attribute reference describes properties of the EcucAbstractRefer- enceDef that is owned by the a valid target of the URI-based reference. Impor- tant properties in the context are, for example, the shortName and the multiplicity ( lowerMultiplicity and upperMultiplicity ) of the EcucAbstractRe- ferenceDef .
